discernment-gate-v1-mechanical.description: Seven-valence discernment of experience-moments; mints :story-point attestations.
discernment-gate-v1-mechanical.closureRationale: This gate MINTS attestations, so its answer creates standing others will rely on. An unmatched moment must yield no story-point rather than a provisional one: absence of discernment is a refusal to mint, never 'unknown, so mint and revisit'. Minting on silence would manufacture the very evidence the attestation graph exists to earn.

reach-gate-v1.description: Attestation-graph-aggregated reach level for content-node subjects.
reach-gate-v1.closureRationale: Gates disclosure on CapabilityInvoke, and disclosure is irreversible — bytes served cannot be unserved. Absence of aggregated reach is a refusal to widen, never 'serve it and find out'. Matches the posture on epr:registry:axis:reach, whose verdict layer this gate invokes; the two must not disagree about what silence means.

content-safety-gate-v1.description: Wide protocol gate evaluating content body / payload safety for ContentPublish, AttestationWrite, and PeerMessage events. Emits Allow or Decline{category:content-safety}. Runs before specialised domain gates.
content-safety-gate-v1.closureRationale: Runs BEFORE the specialised domain gates, so its silence would propagate into every gate downstream. A safety gate that cannot evaluate must decline rather than defer: 'we could not tell' and 'it is fine' are the two readings an open posture cannot distinguish here, and only one of them is safe. Declining is recoverable; a wrongly-published payload is not.
